g.text: Event → Action → render: how one input reaches the screen
[Ctrl/Cmd+T W R L F H B, Tab, 1-9]
consumed: the page never sees it,
even when it has the focus
[Enter / ↑ / ↓ / Esc in #url, Enter / Esc in #find, Esc in #side-search]
the event too: pages may handle Esc
set_html(region, html) when the string changed
sync_attr(id, name, value) when the live attribute differs
Click before Blur: choosing a suggestion with the pointer
Select(7): the tab is switched first
Blur of #url (the default action clears focus)
